frictions.description: `agent-browser find testid "book-status-filter-all" click` failed with 'Element is covered by <p.text-muted-foreground.m-0> at its click point' - the status filter buttons in the Book filter bar are covered by another element for CDP clicks (round 1 saw the same on the sidebar group button).
`fill` on the booking sheet's native date input (data-testid=booking-date-input) does not update the React state - the value stays 2026-10-16 and the availability call keeps using the old date.
frictions.resolution: Set the value with the native HTMLInputElement value setter and dispatched input+change events (the round-1 guidance for React-controlled inputs).

frictions.description: The booking sheet keeps its previous state when closed and reopened: the returning-guest card and the guest name/phone/email from the earlier lookup survived, so a 'fresh guest' booking needed the fields cleared by hand first.
frictions.resolution: Refilled name/phone/email before submitting and verified no dietary tags were selected from the previous guest.

frictions.description: The auto-assigned best-fit table ignores the selected Dining Area: the sheet sent areaId=area_acme_main (and the API stored area_pref_id=area_acme_main) but the planner assigned G4-2 in a different area (G4-Area) although free Main Dining Room tables (M3/M4, max 4) existed on that date. The engine only constrains by area when areaPrefStrict=true (tenant-api rsv-booking-service.ts:853), and the booking sheet exposes no strict-area toggle.
frictions.resolution: Recorded as an observation; not a clause of VAL-BOOK-002/003, which only require the diningAreaId preference to persist and a best-fit table/occupancy to be assigned.

frictions.description: Nothing on the Book list exposes a literal 'booked' status button; booked/confirmed are grouped under 'Upcoming' (book.tsx BookStatusFilter).
frictions.resolution: Tested 'Upcoming' (booked+confirmed) vs 'Cancelled' and recorded the mapping.

frictions.description: No slot on 2026-10-29 was near its pacing cap (19/19 slots available), so the staff pacing warning still could not be observed live - same as round 1.
frictions.resolution: Reported honestly; the slot grid renders and the pacing-asterisk path exists in booking-sheet.tsx but was not triggered.

frictions.description: The contract still names `rsv_reservation_tables`; no such table exists in the tenant schema (assignment lives in rsv_table_occupancies).
frictions.resolution: Verified the assignment and window in rsv_table_occupancies (already recorded as a contract-vs-implementation deviation in round 1).

frictions.description: The business date flipped from 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-17 during the session (04:00 UTC, org tz America/New_York).
frictions.resolution: Ran the VAL-BOOK-008/009/010 checks on 2026-10-16 before the flip and read the Today business date from the screen afterwards; no hardcoded assumptions.

frictions.description: Concurrent setup data from other validators is visible in the service/area pickers (G5/G9/G10/G15/G17 services and areas) and my auto-assigned table came from a round-1 validator's G4-Area table set.
frictions.resolution: Re-read live pickers/day data instead of assuming seeded rows; no interference with the assertion outcomes.

summary: Re-tested 7 assertions on the App operator UI (acme, session c7e026d0d5c8__r2-book-ui): 6 pass, 1 fail. Fixed and verified: VAL-BOOK-008 (service selector now narrows Lunch to rsv_acme_5/rsv_acme_7 and Dinner to the 6 dinner rows; header counters 11/30, 1/2, 5/18 match the day-feed `counters` and the listed active rows), VAL-BOOK-009 (all four search modes plus status, area, source and tag filters narrow, and area+status / source+status intersect), VAL-BOOK-013 (the sheet loads GET /reservations/:id and /events, renders confirmation code, status, date/time/duration, party, tables, source, occasion, notes, CRM visit summary and a timestamped history with actor kinds, from both Book and Today), plus regressions VAL-BOOK-001 (lookup 200 + inline guest creation 201 with a new rsv_guests row), VAL-BOOK-002 (availability 200 + auto-assigned G4-2 with a 120-minute occupancy row) and VAL-BOOK-010 (empty state + clean reset). VAL-BOOK-003 remains `fail` on one round-1 sub-issue: GET /operator/reservations/book/reservations/:id still returns occasion='tag_acme_anniversary' (occasionTagId='tag_acme_anniversary') instead of the chosen value 'anniversary'; the detail sheet, diningAreaId, durationMin=120, dietaryNotes, internalNotes, the new free-text dietary input and the 120-minute occupancy window all pass. No console errors in any flow; no blockers. Created rows: rsv_2c6ceac1-fc51-4583-bea6-6c5be1607cd1 (#EGUG84, 2026-10-29) and gst_634d8348-475c-456f-a7bf-604f583aae69.
